purpose: Record current primary-source evidence for Coinbase's RLUSD distribution, Circle/USDC economics, Ripple's national trust-bank charter, Aviva's XRPL tokenized fund share class, Standard Chartered's RLUSD custody, and SBI's XRP distribution channels. Separate institutional adoption from actual XRP capital.

sources.title: RLUSD is now available on Coinbase
claims: Coinbase added Ripple USD (RLUSD) to Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and the Coinbase app in supported regions.
At launch, clients can deposit and withdraw RLUSD across the XRP Ledger, Base and Ethereum.
Coinbase says customers can convert US dollars into RLUSD at a 1:1 rate.
Coinbase says access for Coinbase Global Exchange customers, including use of RLUSD as collateral, will follow; this was not described as live at launch.
Coinbase says Ripple will provide liquidity on Base to support RLUSD use on that network.
limitations: The announcement does not disclose RLUSD balances, deposits, withdrawals, trading volume, customer counts or collateral posted.
The announcement does not establish XRP purchases, XRP collateral use or XRP as the settlement asset for RLUSD transfers.
Coinbase Global Exchange collateral support is explicitly future/planned at the announcement date.
Availability is limited to supported regions.

sources.title: Coinbase Q3 2026 earnings release
claims: Coinbase reports 10.7% crypto trading-volume market share in Q3 2026 and a fourth consecutive quarter of market-share gains.
Coinbase reports assets on platform equal to 12.5% of total crypto market capitalization.
Average USDC held in Coinbase products reached USD 22 billion, up 49% year over year and approximately 30% of average USDC market capitalization.
Coinbase reports that it captured approximately 50% of USDC economics over the preceding year.
Subscription and services revenue represented 49% of Q3 net revenue; stablecoin revenue was approximately USD 307 million.
Coinbase reports 179% compound annual growth in crypto derivatives trading volume over the preceding two years.
Coinbase reports prediction markets exceeding USD 200 million in annualized revenue.
Coinbase reports Q3 net income of USD 719 million and adjusted net income of USD 78 million.
limitations: These are company-reported metrics and definitions; market-share and revenue calculations require the earnings deck and 10-Q for full methodology.
The USDC metrics do not disclose XRP-specific balances, trading, custody or revenue.
The RLUSD listing announcement does not quantify whether RLUSD changes Coinbase's USDC economics.
Net income and adjusted net income differ materially; net income should not be treated as recurring operating earnings.

sources.publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
sources.title: Corporate Applications Search — Ripple National Trust Bank
claims: The OCC record identifies Ripple National Trust Bank, proposed charter number 25364, as a national trust-bank charter application.
The record shows approval on 2025-12-12 and Consummated/Effective status on 2026-10-26.
The record states that trust powers were requested.
limitations: The record does not establish that Ripple National Trust Bank is a general commercial deposit-taking bank.
The charter record alone does not establish XRP reserves, XRP collateral use, XRP market purchases or a live retail banking product.
Specific approved activities and operational launch status require the charter documents and subsequent regulatory disclosures.

sources.title: Aviva Investors launches tokenised share class for Sterling Liquidity Fund
claims: Aviva Investors launched a tokenized share class of its Sterling Liquidity Fund on the XRP Ledger.
Aviva says it invested GBP 50 million in the new tokenized share class.
The conventional Sterling Liquidity Fund has approximately GBP 22 billion in assets under management.
Aviva reports more than GBP 86 million invested across its two tokenized liquidity-fund share classes, including the earlier USD share class.
The product uses a digital-twin model: holdings are represented on-chain while the existing fund and its underlying assets remain off-chain.
Aviva identifies BNY Mellon as fund custodian, Komainu as regulated digital-asset custodian and Licuido as tokenization infrastructure provider.
limitations: The GBP 22 billion figure is the conventional fund's AUM, not assets moved onto XRPL.
The GBP 50 million investment is in tokenized fund shares, not XRP.
No XRP amount purchased, XRP collateral balance, secondary-market turnover, holder count or network-fee total is disclosed.
Tokenized share representation does not imply that the fund's underlying gilts or cash are held on XRPL.

sources.title: Standard Chartered launches RLUSD custody and joins planned collateral integration with Ripple and LMAX Group
claims: Standard Chartered says institutional custody support for RLUSD issued on XRPL is live for eligible clients through its DIFC branch regulated by the Dubai Financial Services Authority.
Standard Chartered, Ripple and LMAX Group are working toward making RLUSD eligible collateral for agreed LMAX products.
The planned collateral arrangement uses Standard Chartered's collateral-mirroring model so underlying RLUSD need not be transferred directly to the trading venue.
limitations: The LMAX collateral functionality remains subject to final documentation, successful testing, applicable laws and regulations, internal approvals and jurisdictional readiness.
The announcement discloses no client count, assets under custody, RLUSD balances, trading volume or XRP purchases.
Live RLUSD custody is not evidence that native XRP is held as collateral.

sources.title: SBI VISA Crypto Card current product and reward terms
claims: A cardholder selects one crypto asset per card from BTC, ETH or XRP.
The current product page says Standard earns one point worth JPY 1 per JPY 200 spent and Gold earns two points worth JPY 2 per JPY 200 spent.
Points for the monthly period from the 6th through the 5th are credited around the 17th and automatically exchanged into the selected crypto by month-end without an exchange fee.
The conversion quantity uses SBI VC Trade's displayed sales price at 06:59:59 on the day before conversion; XRP quantities are truncated to seven decimal places.
The page displayed a campaign for applications from 2026-09-01 through 2026-10-31, with reward delivery targeted by 2027-02-28.
limitations: The application window ended at the 2026-10-31 Japan-date boundary; the page was retrieved at 23:40 JST on October 31 while the window was still open.
No cardholder count, XRP selection share, monthly XRP reward units, realized aggregate credits or XRP inventory source is disclosed.
The displayed sales-price reference is not an execution record and does not prove an open-market purchase.
Reward conversion is a distribution mechanism; it must not be counted as net external XRP capital without sourcing and execution evidence.

sources.title: Crypto-asset Exchange — SBI VC Trade
claims: SBI states that its exchange handles XRP.
SBI describes an Accumulation Service that automatically purchases selected crypto-assets on a regular schedule using a predetermined amount and frequency.
limitations: No XRP-specific subscriber count, purchase volume, order-flow amount, asset-selection share, execution venue or sourcing method is disclosed.

sources.publisher: SBI VC Trade and Orient Corporation
sources.title: Orico Points can be exchanged for BTC, ETH or XRP
claims: Eligible Orico Point members can exchange 1,200 points for JPY 1,000 worth of BTC, ETH or XRP through an SBI VC Trade account.
The credited crypto quantity is calculated using SBI VC Trade's sales price at the specified following-month valuation time.
limitations: No XRP-specific redemption count, aggregate value, selection share, execution venue or inventory sourcing is disclosed.
This is an opt-in points-redemption channel, not a published open-market purchase schedule.

sources.title: SBI VC Trade begins handling RLUSD in Japan
claims: SBI VC Trade announced RLUSD handling beginning June 24, 2026.
SBI and Ripple describe the listing as a result of their longstanding partnership.
limitations: The listing announcement does not disclose RLUSD balances, payment volume or XRP demand.
The announcement alone does not establish RLUSD deposit/withdrawal support on XRPL; network-specific support must be verified separately.

sources.title: Joint venture with Circle Internet Holdings
claims: SBI announced a joint venture with Circle Internet Holdings to promote USDC circulation and new Web3/digital-finance use cases in Japan.
SBI stated that it acquired USD 50 million of Circle shares as a strategic investor in connection with Circle's NYSE listing.
limitations: The equity investment is in Circle, not XRP, and does not establish an XRP reserve.
The joint venture does not imply that SBI has chosen Circle's network exclusively.

sources.title: Circle launches Arc mainnet
claims: Circle announced Arc mainnet with USDC-denominated gas fees and a founding-validator cohort that includes SBI Group.
Circle lists Coinbase among the digital-asset exchanges providing access to Arc.
Circle describes USDC, EURC and tokenized assets as core Arc assets.
limitations: SBI validator status does not establish capital deployed or transaction volume.
Coinbase's exchange-access role does not establish a bilateral Coinbase-SBI commercial contract.
Arc's USDC gas model does not require XRP as the network fee asset.

independence_policy.rule: Group sources by issuer. Coinbase earnings and Coinbase RLUSD launch are one Coinbase source family; SBI product pages and SBI group releases are related corporate sources; Circle and Standard Chartered statements are separate issuer groups; OCC and Aviva are separate primary institutions.
independence_policy.corroboration: Prefer regulator records, actual chain data, custodian disclosures and fund documents for independently verifiable implementation. A company launch announcement proves the announced product status, not usage or volume.
independence_policy.actual_capital: Separate fund subscriptions, customer balances, rewards, exchange inventory, spot executions, OTC purchases, stablecoin issuance and XRP purchases. Never equate tokenized fund AUM or USDC balances with XRP demand.
